V-E-002.verification: Authorization bypass testing (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite)

V-E-004.verification: Physical security inspection of debug interfaces

V-NET-001.verification: Port scan from each external network zone; compare open ports with the documented allow list

V-NET-003.verification: Inventory listening services and enabled protocols of the release build; compare with the required service list

V-NET-004.verification: Check the listen addresses of all services; scan the external interfaces for management and debug services

V-AC-001.verification: Review the role model and assignments; test that each role can perform only its permitted operations

V-AC-002.verification: Test the access policy with attribute combinations at and beyond the permitted limits

V-AC-003.verification: List the user and capabilities of every running service; verify none runs as root without a documented reason

V-OS-001.verification: Verify enforcing mode and a loaded profile for every service; review denials from an exploitation test

V-OS-002.verification: Check that seccomp filters are active for exposed services; test that a disallowed system call is blocked

V-OS-004.verification: Compare kernel configuration and runtime settings with the hardening baseline

V-OS-006.verification: Run the automated baseline check on the release build; review deviations and their justification

V-OPS-001.verification: Check that the SBOM is current and that known vulnerabilities are assessed and patched within the defined time
